_comment: Authoritative publication list.  CSL-JSON, so a reference manager can read
it and Python needs no dependency to parse it.  See docs/adr/006.
Built by reconciling the three lists that previously disagreed: docs/cv.md,
the Zola research page, and the Zotero export at src/pubs.json in the Zola
repository.  scripts/python/reconcile_bibliography.py reproduces that
comparison; docs/adr/006 records what it found.
`issued` is the publication year.  `_preprint` carries the arXiv posting
year where it differs -- Zotero recorded those as `issued`, which is why
its years looked wrong against the other two lists.
`_needs_review` marks a field the three sources disagree on and that could
not be settled from them.  Four remain, and all four are decisions for a
person rather than facts to look up: whether to split an entry in two,
whether to trust the CV over the research page about a venue, which
replacement link to use.  Each note records what the publishers do say.
Every entry carrying a DOI or an arXiv identifier has been checked against
the publisher's own record -- Crossref, DataCite or the arXiv API -- by
scripts/python/verify_bibliography.py.  `make publications-verify` repeats
the comparison and reports every difference.  The four entries with neither
identifier are reconciled claims still, and the verifier lists them as
unverifiable rather than passing over them.

items.title: A machine-checked proof of Birkhoff's variety theorem in Martin-Löf type theory
items.container-title: 27th International Conference on Types for Proofs and Programs (TYPES 2021)
items._needs_review: One entry or two? The proceedings paper is DataCite 10.4230/LIPIcs.TYPES.2021.4 -- LIPIcs vol. 239, pp. 4:1-4:21, 2022, by DeMeo and Carette -- and its record names arXiv:2101.10166 as a version of it (relationType IsVersionOf), so the publisher treats them as one work. The research page disagrees, calling 2101.10166 the unabridged 35-page version of the TYPES submission under a different title, 'The Agda Universal Algebra Library and Birkhoff's Theorem in Dependent Type Theory', and arXiv's own abstract page says the same. If they are separate works this should be two entries; the DOI, volume and pages here belong to the proceedings paper either way. Author order and title are settled: arXiv and DataCite both give DeMeo before Carette.

The evidence favours the CV -- Crossref has 10.1109/LICS52264.2021.9470670, 'Constraint Satisfaction Problems over Finite Structures' in '2021 36th Annual ACM/IEEE Symposium on Logic in Computer Science (LICS)', pages 1-13, by Barto, DeMeo and Mottet, and arXiv 2010.04958 carries that same DOI with journal_ref 'LICS 2021 pages 1--13'. Adding the DOI and pages is left for William to confirm.
